scope: Server Teams.import/export on canonical species and common text syntax; not database aliases, legality, client-only syntax, or packed teams.
intentionalDifferences: Koffing follows the client in deriving hpType from a bracketed Hidden Power move; the server only normalizes the move name.
Koffing keeps sparse fields; comparisons fill Showdown defaults only for semantic comparison.
Koffing preserves Dynamax Level; this server release exports it but ignores it during text import.

Koffing does not infer generation-specific Hidden Power IVs. The server text importer initializes IVs before its inference branch, so its missing-IV behavior is not a reliable client compatibility reference.
Koffing retains collection boundaries and metadata; the server importer flattens team backups.
